        "Full31-file owned diff read. Named Gecko-service accessors replace XPCOM retrieval for IO/nsINetUtil, category/directory/window/stream conversion, cache, permissions, IDN, console, socket/stream transport, random generator, MIME header parameters, certificate DB and string bundles. Those services live upstream; comm call-site/return and ownership contracts are authoritative here, while paired Gecko accessor/availability internals are not inferred.",
        "Operation checks remain for escaping, category entry/factory creation, file properties, stream transport, header decoding and certificate construction. Content policy stores PermissionManager as a member. The random generator MOZ_ASSERT retains a nonempty message; proxy helper moves rv into DEBUG scope for its URI assertion. Removing retrieval checks does not authorize removing method-result checks or prove every service is nonnull during shutdown.",
        "IMAP uses SocketTransport as an nsIEventTarget and dispatches named SyncRunnable callbacks. IsAlive and StartTLS closures retain strong transport/control values and share the stack rv; GetTransportSecurityInfo shares local control/secInfo and AddRefs the returned result. This call structure relies on synchronous dispatch, whose paired Gecko implementation/runtime is outside this packet. Some existing socket/converter guards remain in the diff; no uniform guard-removal rule is inferred.",
        "GetCacheStorage still owns mCacheStorage in the service, chooses disk/memory storage, checks its creation result and AddRefs the caller result. No tests change and no threading, cache, security or conversion runtime ran.",
